name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.90.2 — the frontend-design rule becomes mechanism, per core § Doctrine Authoring and § Incident Policy: one binding home (doctrine/mocks.md § Mocks: Authoring Rules; the mocks and sketch commands shrink to pointers, the incident quotes are gone), and the mocks driver prints the skill line from a real probe (`claude plugin list --json`) on every authoring step block (SHAPES, WIREFRAMES, THEME, SKIN) and as `skill-check` for /spec:sketch's setup — installed → load it, not installed/disabled → one ⚠️ remedy line, no CLI → unverifiable reason; exit 0 on every outcome, never a stop; the prose-regex pin from 7.90.0/7.90.1 is replaced by a behavioral test driving a fake `claude` on PATH. 7.90.1/7.90.0 — the rule itself: every mock authored under the skill, missing skill warns and continues; atlas card preview cap 260px. 7.89.0 — atlas cards clamp every mock preview to one fixed height (`.shot` max-height 260px, overridable via `--v-shot-max`); the clipped remainder fades out and the click-to-inspect lightbox still shows the full mock — a tall mock no longer makes a tall card (JJ 2026-09-06).
